standard_prerequisites.name: Continuous and cocontinuous functors
standard_prerequisites.use: Fix the two conditions to be verified for F and the resulting morphism of topoi.

standard_prerequisites.name: Representable fibres go up
standard_prerequisites.use: Identifies F(x_i x_x x') with F(x_i) x_{F(x)} F(x') in the continuity check.

standard_prerequisites.name: Morphism of topoi from cocontinuous functor
standard_prerequisites.use: Yield the final assertion f^{-1}(G)(x) = G(F(x)) from continuity and cocontinuity.

core_obligations: Continuity (1): F maps coverings to coverings since it preserves strongly cartesian morphisms.
Continuity (2): base-change x_i x_x x' exists and is strongly cartesian; F of it is strongly cartesian over F(x'), hence equals the fibre product there.

Cocontinuity: given a covering {y_i -> F(x)}, pick strongly cartesian lifts x_i -> x over the same base arrows; unique isomorphisms F(x_i) -> y_i over F(x) exhibit the covering as the F-image of a covering of X.
Conclude the topos-morphism assertion from the sites lemmas.
proof_roadmap: Verify the two continuity conditions and cocontinuity by transporting coverings through strongly cartesian morphisms, then quote the standard topos consequences.
difficulty_reason: Three separate verifications (two continuity parts and cocontinuity), with the cocontinuity step needing a construction of a compatible covering by strongly cartesian lifts.
